correctness.rationale: Verified marked-site gaps give exact A_{n,k}=(n/k) C(n-2k-1,k-1); the deficit-r relative weight m/(m+2r) C(m+2r,3r) (27 c m^3)^(-r) converges under factorial domination to u^(3r)/(3r)!. Conditional fixed-r slack unit placements converge to independent uniform positions, producing the random phase-slip integral I_{3r,j}; bounded Fourier amplitude gives dominated convergence across all r. The binomial count of phase slips between two points gives the integral line-shape; for j=0 Dirichlet spacings yield E|I_{3r,0}|^2=1/(3r+1), hence H1/(9H0) and both c endpoint laws. Independently enumerated admissible masks n=9,12,15 at c=1 for central near-Bragg intensities 0.11045548485965671,0.11049917680750448,0.11052249599452853, approaching calculated H1/(9H0)=0.1105996842877004. These finite tests supplement, not replace, the proof; no uniform j or arbitrary n limit is asserted.
